title: Mishlove's accredited doctorate in parapsychology

tellings.quote: I think I'm the only person in the world ever to have achieved an accredited doctoral diploma that says parasychology right on the diploma.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, who studies psychic phenomena, says that in the 1970s at the University of California, Berkeley, he earned what he thinks is the only accredited doctorate in the world with the word "parapsychology", the study of psychic abilities, printed right on the diploma. He tells Michels this about himself.
